title: Forward PAGER parameters to the temp file pager and tokenize less raw-mode detection
summary:
`_tempfilepager` now receives `cmd_params` and runs the pager as `[cmd_path, *cmd_params, tempfile]`. Before, it ran `[cmd_path, tempfile]` and dropped flags from `PAGER`. On Windows, `PAGER="less -R"` now runs `less -R` on the temporary file.

`_pipepager` now decides whether `less` already shows raw color through a new helper, `_less_uses_raw_mode`. The helper shlex-splits `LESS`, appends `cmd_params`, and accepts only dash-prefixed short-option clusters containing `r`/`R` or the exact `--raw-control-chars` token. The old check matched any `r` or `R` anywhere in the joined string. The less match now compares `cmd_path.stem`, so `less.exe` counts, and it casefolds on Windows. `LESS=-R` is still injected only when both `LESS` and `cmd_params` are empty.

changes.what: `_pager_contextmanager` passes `cmd_params` to `_tempfilepager`. `_tempfilepager` gains a `cmd_params` argument and adds it to the `subprocess.call` argv before the file name. Adds `_less_uses_raw_mode(less_env, cmd_params)`. `_pipepager` matches less on `cmd_path.stem`, casefolded under `WIN`, and calls the new helper instead of a substring check.
changes.why: Users get their `PAGER` flags on the temp file backend. Fewer filenames and option values falsely enable color. Inputs that do not fit the token rules no longer enable color, including dash-less `LESS` values and abbreviated long options.

changes.what: Adds `test_pipepager_less_detection_matches_stem`, `test_pipepager_less_detection_case_insensitive_on_windows`, a parametrized `test_pipepager_less_raw_mode_detection` with a `_FakePagerProcess` Popen stub, and `test_tempfile_pager_passes_pager_params` using `head -n 1`. `_force_tempfile_pager` now runs `shutil.which` on only the first shlex token of `pager_cmd`.
changes.why: Covers stem matching, token-based detection, and forwarding of parameters. The helper change lets `pager_cmd` carry arguments.

changes.what: Adds two Unreleased entries: temp file pager forwards `PAGER` parameters, and raw mode detection parses option tokens.

flow.caption: `get_pager_file` resolves `PAGER` into a command path and params. `_pager_contextmanager` routes them to either the pipe backend or the temp file backend. The pipe backend asks `_less_uses_raw_mode` whether to enable color.

risks.title: Dash-less LESS values like `FRX` no longer enable color
risks.reason: `less` accepts option letters in `LESS` without a leading dash; git, for example, sets `LESS=FRX`. The old check found `R` in that string and set `color = True`. The new loop skips tokens that do not start with `-`, so `FRX` returns False. `LESS` is non-empty, so `-R` is not injected either. ANSI codes are then stripped where they used to be shown.

risks.title: Abbreviated `--raw` long option not detected
risks.reason: `less` accepts unambiguous long-option prefixes such as `--raw`. The new code requires the exact `--raw-control-chars` token, so `PAGER="less --raw"` leaves color off. The old substring check enabled it.

risks.title: Option arguments in short clusters cause false positives
risks.reason: Any dash token containing `r` counts, including values attached to options such as `-pError` (search pattern) or `-+R` (reset R to default). These report raw mode as on when less does not use it, so ANSI output passes through unfiltered.

tests.description: Set `LESS=FRX` and `PAGER=less`, call `click.echo_via_pager` with styled text. Confirm whether color is kept, and compare against the pre-PR behavior.
Run `_pipepager(Path("/x/less"), ["--raw"])` with `LESS` unset. Confirm the returned color matches the intended behavior for abbreviated long options.
On Windows, set `PAGER="less -R"` and run `echo_via_pager` with ANSI text. Confirm `less` receives `-R` before the temp file path and renders color.
On Windows with `PAGER=more`, confirm `echo_via_pager` still opens the temp file with an empty `cmd_params` list.
Run the new tests in `tests/test_termui.py` on Linux and Windows CI. Confirm the `head -n 1` test runs where `head` exists and prints only `line one`.
Set `PAGER=less` with `LESS` unset. Confirm the spawned process env has `LESS=-R` and that color is True.
